sourceOfTruth: NormanAI-CRMx (SQLite). Research is discovery/qualify only — never scores Fit, never writes Notion as SoR.

verifiedPublicIntake.evidence: CRMx fail-closed evidence ingest (schema norman.research.crmx_evidence.v1). Research promote always passes --evidence; missing sidecar fails closed. See NormanAI-CRMx docs/research-evidence-handoff.md.
verifiedPublicIntake.csvContract: Crunchbase-export column names (Organization Name, Website, LinkedIn, …). Research remaps its internal candidate fields into this shape before promote.
verifiedPublicIntake.richerIntake: Research always writes a versioned evidence JSON sidecar (nyc_evidence, source_urls, keyword_hits, signal_notes) beside the CSV and passes it to ingest_csv via --evidence. Research will not invent Notion writes or Fit scores to preserve evidence.

fundingHandoff.note: Strict funding watcher still uses norman.research.funding_handoff.v1 → legacy crm-core crm_funding_handoff.py. No public CRMx funding-handoff CLI was verified. Do not retarget that path until CRMx publishes one.
